newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bomb wounds 3 pro-Israeli militiamen in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Bomb wounds 3 pro-Israeli militiamen in Lebanon.

text.p: A roadside bomb seriously wounded three Israeli-backed militiamen in south Lebanon on Wednesday, militia sources said.
The explosion hit a South Lebanon Army (SLA) armoured troop carrier on the road of Roum-Anan in the Jezzine area, the sources said.
Jezzine is officially outside Israel's 15-km (nine miles) deep south Lebanon occupation zone but under SLA control.
There was no immediate claim of responsibility for the attack.
Moslem and leftist guerrilla groups, mainly the pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God), are fighting to oust Israel from its occpation zone.
